title: Folio Assistant platform terms
description: Terms the platform introduced in September 2026, each defined where its schema defines it and linked to the W3C concept it corresponds to, rather than copying that concept's definition. Terms whose source is in cat-harness are in cat-harness's scheme of the same id (`cat-harness.glossary.json` beside this file), minted in cat-harness's namespace: a term lives in the namespace of the instance that owns its source (owner, 2026-09-24).

terms.definition: An instance's terms and what they mean, as a SKOS concept scheme: local terms linked to external concepts, plus external concepts listed without being copied.
